name: Visibility Prefiltering
definition: A technique to reduce correlated artifacts from Riemann sums by replacing the single blocker depth S[γ] with a distribution of depths, approximating the percentage of visibility that changes along β.
summary: Visibility Prefiltering reduces correlated artifacts in volumetric shadowing by storing a distribution of blocker depths instead of a single value, converting structured aliasing into less objectionable noise with fewer light rays.
